about.title: Our Story
about.subtitle: Luxury Comfort Redefined
about.description: At Bella Notte, we offer a luxurious comfort experience that combines the softness of natural cotton with elegant design details, creating peaceful moments with beauty that reflects simplicity.
about.missionText: To be the premier destination for luxury home fashion in the Arab world, elevating comfort and quality standards to create a brand that embodies sophisticated femininity every beautiful night.
about.visionText: We provide high-quality products made from 100% natural cotton with contemporary luxury designs.
about.goal1: The first Saudi brand specialized in offering high-quality products made from 100% natural cotton with contemporary, luxurious, and elegant designs.
about.goal2: Enhance the brand's visual identity to become a symbol of comfort and nighttime elegance.
about.goal3: Gradual expansion in pajama collections to suit different tastes and seasons.
about.goal4: Build deep loyalty with customers through a refined shopping experience and exceptional service.
about.goal5: Sustainability through the use of natural materials that are skin-friendly and supportive of quality of life.
about.goal6: Reach Gulf and Arab markets as a luxury brand in women's homewear.

returnPolicy.title: Exchange and Return Policy
returnPolicy.content: Thank you for your trust in our store. For your safety and in compliance with the regulations of the Ministry of Commerce in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, we would like to clarify that sleepwear products are classified among products that cannot be exchanged or returned after receipt, due to reasons related to public health and personal hygiene, in accordance with the E-Commerce Law and Consumer Protection Regulations.
